classification.difficultyReason: Applies the vocabulary cluster, gap and outlier to one plot, with no counting.

content.prompt: Consider the dot plot to the right, which shows the daily rainfall over 20 days.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Where is most of the data clustered?

answer.worked: All days except one lie in the group from $0$ mm to $4$ mm.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Identify the gap in the data.

answer.short: No days had 5, 6, 7 or 8 mm of rainfall.
answer.worked: There are no dots from $5$ mm to $8$ mm.
The value $9$ mm is separated from the other values by the gap at $5\text{–}8$ mm.
